selection_type: targeted regression pilot, not benchmark-wide representative sample
ordering: paired task/repetition blocks, randomized order with fixed seed 20261023; all repeated trials start fresh
controls: same exact model route and sampling parameters
same base image and task/verifier hashes
same provider-account assignment within each pair
identical transport, billing and dependency handling
freeze sources before first paid trial
no inter-task memory or solution reuse
metrics: official pass rate and paired gains/losses
total cost divided by official passes
all model requests including retries and compaction
solver decision rounds excluding auxiliary calls
analysis: Pair by task and repetition; resample entire task clusters for uncertainty. Report all tasks, historical-success stratum, and both-pass pairs separately. Both-pass filtering is diagnostic only. Budget failures remain algorithm outcomes. Unresolved usage is reported as an interval, not zero. Engineering-fault repair consumes the same trial budget and cannot be repeated to chase success.
interpretation: Targets are prespecified practical goals, not guarantees. A small zero-drop pilot supports expansion; it cannot establish exact population-level equality. Report confidence intervals and failure transitions. Cost reduction caused by earlier failed submission does not count as successful optimization.
